description: 数据分析 Agent 的查数与待澄清样本。查数题按 easy、mid、hard 各 8 条，澄清题 6 条。本地 JSON 是维护来源。

inputs.question: 订单一共有多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced')

inputs.question: 全部评论的平均评分是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced')

inputs.question: 每种支付方式的支付总额分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT p.payment_type, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM payments p INNER JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') GROUP BY p.payment_type

inputs.question: 每种支付方式的平均分期数分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT p.payment_type, AVG(p.payment_installments) AS avg_installments FROM payments p INNER JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') GROUP BY p.payment_type

inputs.question: 2017 年每个月有多少订单？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS sales_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m')

inputs.question: 2017 年的平均配送天数是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

inputs.question: 2017 年的准时交付率是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

inputs.question: 2017 年每个月有多少延迟订单？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS sales_month, SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m')

inputs.question: 2018 年一共有多少订单？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'

inputs.question: 2017 年的延迟交付率是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS delay_rate FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

inputs.question: 2018 年有多少延迟订单？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'

inputs.question: 2017 年 SP 州各客户城市的独立客户数分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP' AND o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_city

inputs.question: 2017 年每个月的成交额分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS sales_month, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_gmv FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m')

inputs.question: 2018 年的平均客单价是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_basket FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'

inputs.question: 2017 年各客户州的平均配送天数分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_state

inputs.question: 2017 年每个月的总运费分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS sales_month, SUM(oi.freight_value) AS total_freight FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m')

inputs.question: 2017 年各卖家州的订单数分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY s.seller_state

inputs.question: 2018 年各客户州的支付总额分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM orders o INNER JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_state

inputs.question: 2018 年各客户州的平均评分分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_state

inputs.question: 2017 年订单数最多的 10 个卖家是哪些？订单数相同则按卖家标识从小到大取前 10 名。

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_orders DESC, s.seller_id ASC LIMIT 10

inputs.question: 2017 年哪个客户州的 GMV 最高？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_gmv FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_gmv DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: 2017 年各英文品类的成交额分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category_english, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_gmv FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)

inputs.question: 2017 年卖家州为 SP 的平均客单价是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_basket FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP' AND o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

inputs.question: 2017 年各英文品类的差评率分别是多少？

outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category_english, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS bad_review_rate FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name INNER JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'created', 'approved', 'processing', 'invoiced') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
